bug_summary: build_amended_fold_construction_plan() bound the field 'siw_source_split_identity' to split_lock['policy_lock_identity'] (the identity of the FROZEN RULE: seed/ratio/stratification) instead of the actual deterministic video assignment's own identity (compute_siw_video_split()'s 'split_identity', i.e. split_lock['proposed_split']['split_identity']). These are different concepts and were conflated.
affected_committed_artifact_note: the committed 836f74a artifact is left exactly as it was (buggy field binding preserved for historical record); this correction file documents the discrepancy additively and the fixed function is available in the module for all future calls

corrected_binding.siw_source_split_identity_meaning: compute_siw_video_split()'s own split_identity -- the ACTUAL deterministic video train/dev assignment. What a resume/build comparison must match bit-for-bit.
corrected_binding.siw_source_split_policy_lock_identity_me: the identity of the frozen RULE itself (seed=20260901, 80/20 ratio, live/spoof-family stratification). Stays constant even if the underlying population changes and the resulting assignment identity therefore changes.

fix_verification.when_local_raw_data_unavailable: siw_source_split_identity is explicitly None (PLAN_ONLY state), never fabricated
fix_verification.gpu_build_requirement: on the GPU, the persisted frozen split lock (both proposed_split.split_identity AND policy_lock_identity) must match a freshly recomputed one before --e7a-build may write anything -- enforced by e7a_build_preflight's SIW_SPLIT_IDENTITY_MATCH and SIW_POLICY_LOCK_IDENTITY_MATCH checks
